Four layers, from fastest to most realistic.

> **Where to run this.** Commands on this page that start with `npm`, `node` or `docker build` run inside a clone of this repository: `git clone https://github.com/grand-stack/grandstack-web`, then `cd grandstack-web` (Node 22 or later; run `npm ci` once). Commands that need the running stack use the `grandstack` repository's compose files: see the [quickstart](https://www.grandstack.ai/quickstart/).

## 1. Type checking

`npm run typecheck` (also run by `npm run build`) runs `tsc --noEmit`. Because every GraphQL document is typed from the schema, using a field that is not in the query fails here.

## 2. Codegen as a schema check

`npm run codegen` reads the live schema from `GRAPHQL_URL` (default `http://localhost:4000/graphql`) and validates every `graphql()` document against it. An unknown field, a wrong argument type or a duplicate operation name fails the run and writes nothing. Run it after any server schema change, then commit `src/graphql/generated/`.

## 3. Unit tests

`npm test` (vitest) covers the pure logic: URL parsing and `where`/`sort` building for movies and people (`src/lib/*.test.ts`), form validation and mutation inputs including the relationship diff (`src/forms/model.test.ts`), and the poster generator. They need no server or browser.

## 4. Browser end-to-end checks

`npm run e2e` drives real Chrome against the running stack and checks 78 behaviours, including create, edit and delete with the stored film counts. Setup, variables and caveats are in [e2e/README.md](https://github.com/grand-stack/grandstack-web/blob/main/e2e/README.md). In short: run it against a freshly seeded database, because it expects the sample data.

## Continuous integration

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs install, typecheck, unit tests and a build, then builds the Docker image. Codegen and the browser checks need a running server and are not in CI yet.

## When a check fails

- `codegen` fails with `Cannot query field "x" on type "Y"`: the server schema does not have the field; check the server is running the version you expect.
- A query works in GraphiQL but codegen reports `Variable "$x" of type "T" used in position expecting type "T!"`: the variable must be declared non-null where it is used in a non-null position.
- e2e fails on counts: the database is not the freshly seeded sample.
